# Anne Shirley & Ruby Gillis

A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. ## Shared scenes

> While attending school, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is taunted by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who calls her 'Carrots' and pulls her hair. Enraged, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head, leading Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) to punish her by making her stand at the blackboard. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proudly rejects Gilbert's attempt to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) by being forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) after being late to school. Humiliated, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to quit school entirely. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P71](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0071), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the past year since arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and recounts her imaginative adventures to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) asks her to run an errand to the Barrys' house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) confesses she is terrified of crossing the spruce grove because she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imagined it was a haunted wood. To break her of this silly fear, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) insists that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walk through the dark woods anyway, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) does in sheer terror before returning safely.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong

A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P34](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home on the last day of school, emotional after Mr. Phillips's farewell speech and eager about the arrival of Avonlea's new minister, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md), and his wife. [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) prepares to host the new minister and his wife for tea, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) making a layer cake for Mrs. Allan. However, during the tea party, Mrs. Allan and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notice a strange taste in Anne's cake.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P35](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0035)_

> At a party, [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, leading to a fall that breaks Anne's ankle. Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) carries [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to realize how deeply she cares for the girl. During her seven weeks of bed rest, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is comforted by visitors, reflects on her mistakes, and looks forward to returning to school to meet her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and flourishes under her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) organizes a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert to raise money for a school flag, throwing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the other students into excited preparations despite Marilla's skepticism. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her upcoming concert roles with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), finding steady support and encouragement in [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) down the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing their growing up and Anne's melodramatic composition assignment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proposes starting a story club, which quickly expands to include other schoolmates. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the club and its moral lessons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

The Story Club Is Formed P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends re-enact the story of [Elaine](../character/elaine.md), floating [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) down the pond in a leaky boat. After the boat sinks, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) clings to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her, though she refuses his offer of friendship. Back home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on learning not to be overly romantic, but [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gently encourages her to keep a bit of romance in her life.
>

> At Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students settle into their hard work as the school year progresses, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflecting on her softened rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). As spring arrives and final examinations approach, [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), Ruby, and [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to anxiously discuss exams and commencement plans, while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds comfort in nature and her future dreams.
>

> The A.V.I.S. throws a farewell party for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) before they leave for college, though Anne's evening is somewhat ruined by Gilbert's sentimentality and Charlie Sloane's dull company. The next day, after dealing with discouraging goodbyes from local women, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for a peaceful evening walk in the woods with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), restoring her spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P6](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0006), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P38](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0038)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to visit [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), stopping first at the Wright home where [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) treats them with her sharp, unpleasant tongue. Along the way, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares her secret desire to write and publish a short story. When they reach Ruby's home, they find her acting aggressively cheerful and denying her terminal illness while showing off her summer clothes.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XI The Round of Life

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042), [v3 ch.Life P52](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0052), [v3 ch.Life P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends an evening with a dying [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of death and her unfulfilled dreams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers quiet comfort, and Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep the following night. After the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects deeply on life and mortality while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).
>
